transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... I just feel like I'm always moving from one thing to the next. Like I can't really just... sit idle. And, uh... we have a new setup at work lately, and it's just made that a lot harder to hide. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Can you tell me more about not being able to sit idle? Do you feel restless or find yourself needing to move even when you're trying to relax?

Yeah, I suppose. Um... if I have to sit still for a while, like... through a training video at work or a slow appointment, I just start feeling kind of boxed in. Like I need to stand up and stretch, or... just do something with my hands. It's just... yeah. That's about it.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried when you're not able to move or stay busy?
Um... no, not really. I wouldn't say I get worried. Just... uncomfortable, I guess. I don't know about anxious. I just prefer to be doing something. That's all.
Do you find it hard to focus or stay attentive, especially during tasks that require sustained mental effort?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... if we have one of those longer coaching meetings, or I have to read through a new procedure for the calls... I start off okay. But then, after a few minutes, I kind of realize my eyes are just moving across the page, and I didn't actually take in anything I just read. Or heard. So... yeah, I suppose I do.
Do you often find yourself acting on impulse or feeling like you need to jump into things quickly without thinking them through?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I usually just do what I'm supposed to do at work. I don't really jump into things without thinking. I just... take the calls as they come. That's pretty much it.
Do these feelings of restlessness and difficulty focusing happen only at work, or do they also occur in other parts of your life, like at home or with friends?

Um... I guess at home, too. Yeah. Like... quiet stuff. Things that are supposed to relax me. 

If I try reading, or... sitting through a movie with my wife... it usually doesn't last very long before I'm shifting around, I guess. Or making comments. Or I just end up getting up for something. So... yeah.
Looking back, did you experience similar feelings of restlessness or difficulty focusing when you were a child, or did these difficulties mostly start in adulthood?

Um... well, it's been around a long time, I guess. Long before this job change. 

Back in... grade school, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was... bright, but careless. Or that I talked out of turn. They always had to remind me to just... stay with my work. So... yeah. It's not a new thing.
Do you often find yourself talking more than usual, or feeling like you're physically restless, like you can't stay still even if you want to?

Um... I don't know about the talking. But... I guess I do move around a bit. Like, even if I'm just trying to look calm at work... my foot is usually bouncing under the desk. Or I'll be clicking a pen during a meeting and... I don't really notice I'm doing it. Just... small things like that, I guess.
Do you often find yourself forgetting tasks or responsibilities, or losing things like your keys or phone more often than others seem to?

Um... yeah, I guess. At work, mostly. Like... I'll tell myself I need to call a customer back, or... reply to some message after my lunch break. But... if I don't write it down. In a few places, usually... I just forget. Until the next day, maybe. So... yeah, that happens.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't think so. I just... do my normal things. Nothing like that.
